title: OneMedNet Corporation 8-K — Notice of Potential Nasdaq Delisting
summary: OneMedNet Corporation (ONMD) received a Nasdaq staff notice on April 14, 2026 informing the company it is not in compliance with the $1.00 minimum bid price requirement for continued listing on the Nasdaq Capital Market. The company has until October 12, 2026 to regain compliance by maintaining a bid price at or above $1.00 for at least 10 consecutive business days.
key_points: OneMedNet Corporation received a Nasdaq delisting notice on April 14, 2026 due to the stock trading below $1.00 for 30 consecutive business days.
The company has 180 days (until October 12, 2026) to regain compliance with the $1.00 bid price requirement.
To regain compliance, the stock must trade at $1.00 or higher for 10 consecutive business days during the grace period.
If not compliant by October 12, 2026, the company may be eligible for an additional 180-day compliance period if it meets certain criteria.
Management is considering options including a potential reverse stock split to restore compliance.
The company's common stock trades as ONMD and warrants trade as ONMDW on Nasdaq.
